en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Muhammad Bin Ismail Bin Bazie, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> said: ‘My<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Lord<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Commanded me with being polite with the people just as He<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Commanded with the fulfilment of the Obligations’.
en.sarwar: 4. Abu Ali al-Ash’ari has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from Muhammad ibn Isma’il from ibn Bazi’ from Hamza ibn Bazi’ from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:
“The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘My Lord (Allah) has commanded me to be gentle to people just as He has commanded me to fulfill my obligations.’”
